deps.edn.reason: JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :gen, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

test/calendar/overlaps_parity_test.cljk.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.calendar/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.
